# observed-from-side edges are authoritative

If a PR observes an entity's outgoing edges (the 'from' side), dropped imports in that PR remove those outgoing dependency edges even when the target entity is out-of-scope.

To allow partial-observation PRs to assert authoritative changes to outgoing edges from observed entities.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_dropped_import_removes_edge_despite_target_out_of_scope`
